messages:
leo: Quick heads-up: CI started failing SAST on the gateway repo after the KMS key rotation this morning. Failing step shows Decrypt denied.

emma: Can you paste the exact log?

leo: snippet:
```
2026-07-20T07:10:12Z ERROR scanner: failed to fetch encrypted deps
CausedBy: AccessDenied: User arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-scanner cannot perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz99-yy88
```

nina: We rotated the gateway key and tightened the key policy to exclude service/ci roles until we validated new tags. That likely blocked the scanner principal.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2718 for temporary grant + policy exception. ETA 20m.

emma: Proposed quick fix: add a scoped grant for `ci-scanner` on the rotated key with an explicit `Decrypt` operation and a 2h TTL. Avoid a full rollback.

leo: Also requesting scanner side change: treat a decrypt-failure as `info` for 24h so we don't create merge blockers for known infra work. Could add a `suppress:on-kms-deny` annotation on pipeline.

nina: I'll apply the ephemeral grant and update the key policy to reference `aws:PrincipalTag/role=ci-scanner` as a condition instead of broad allow. Patch will go through INFRA-2718.

sec-bot: Audit entries recorded: kms:Decrypt DENY x 12 from ci-scanner between 07:10:00 and 07:12:00. Tagged INFRA-2718.

ops-bot: Grant applied; CI re-run passed SAST checks. Please ensure a follow-up RFC for long-term: `SEC-RFC-2026-11 - CI KMS key lifecycle` and a replay of builds in the window.

emma: Added suppression PR `SAST-PR-412` with expire timestamp and link to INFRA-2718. We'll revert after INFRA-2718 acceptance criteria met.

leo: Thanks all — keeping this thread for follow-up artifacts and audit IDs. Ping me if anything re-fires.
